test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in indirect speech.

She said to me, “I have often told you not to play with fire.”

options.text: She told me that she had often told me not to play with fire.
She asked me that she had often told me not to play with fire.
She told me that she has often told me not to play with fire.
She said to me that she has often told me not to play with fire.

solution:
The correct answer is '**She told me that she had often told me not to play with fire**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence is a direct speech statement, and when converting it into indirect speech, the tense usually shifts back one step.

 
 
• Therefore, "**have**" be
